day_shape: 73 items dominated by IRGC claim of two oil tankers struck by mines east of Hormuz, Axios-sourced reports Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike Iran after US midterms, and IDF announcing 6+ Hamas operatives killed in Gaza strikes.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker mine incidents
threads.summary: Iran's IRGC and state outlets said two oil tankers were struck by sea mines east of the Strait of Hormuz, with one supertanker ablaze, blaming vessels for disabling navigation systems. IRGC Navy claimed 11 tankers had caught fire in the strait over nine days since CENTCOM commander Bert Cooper's 25 October visit.

threads.label: Netanyahu pressing Trump on post-midterm Iran strike
threads.summary: Axios, cited by Jerusalem Post and Iran International, reported Netanyahu is urging Trump to strike Iran immediately after the 4 November US midterms while Washington pursues Qatari-mediated talks. Related Jerusalem Post items said Israel is prepared for a joint US strike and reported a Trump–Netanyahu phone call Saturday as the US laid plans to resume strikes.

threads.label: US–Iran diplomatic track via Qatar
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Qatari mediation has advanced US–Iran talks but the sides remain apart on the nuclear programme, while Iran International said Iranian officials publicly rejected nuclear negotiations and threatened military retaliation. Iran International also profiled JD Vance's reported bid to meet security chief Mohsen Rezaei, and reported Qatar is locking in long-term US LNG supplies against Hormuz disruption.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes on Hamas operatives
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes on Saturday killed at least six Hamas operatives in Gaza, including Nabil Hamad of Hamas's recruitment apparatus, sniper commander Mohannad Dahdouh, and two Nukhba members who took part in the October 7 attack. Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel military correspondent Emanuel Fabian relayed the IDF statements.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon operations and Maronite incidents
threads.summary: The IDF said troops in the southern Lebanon security zone around Al-Khiam uncovered weapons and Hezbollah paraphernalia inside a civilian home with a children's room, plus an explosive-drone storage site. Jerusalem Post reported vandalism of statues at a Maronite church in Nahariya and the killing of Catholic priest Samir Daou in his Lebanese home, allegedly by a Syrian worker.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and nuclear debate
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Mashhad court sentenced three January protest detainees to death for "enmity against God," authorities seized a Tehran art school founder's assets over alleged insults to Shiites, and a University of Tehran PhD student attempted self-immolation after security pressure. A separate Iran International piece said calls to revise nuclear doctrine and build a bomb are gaining prominence on official platforms, and Jerusalem Post reported Halloween participants were beaten and detained in Tehran.

threads.label: Regime messaging: resistance, Bagheri in Beijing, CENTCOM rebuttal
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried heavy resistance and self-sacrifice messaging including the opening of a third military education centre, formation of Iran's "first self-sacrificing battalion," and claims field developments forced Washington to retreat; IRIB said Ali Bagheri met China's foreign minister in Beijing on ending the war. CENTCOM separately posted a rebuttal calling Iran's foreign minister's denial of civilian attacks false, citing more than 20 civilian mariners killed in recent months.
